panels.title: Log rate by severity
panels.description: Lines/sec per classified severity (error/fatal/warn/info). An error or fatal spike surfaces here before you scroll the log below. Follows the env/source/search filters; it ignores the level dropdown because the breakdown already splits by severity.

targets.expr: sum by (sev) (rate({env=~"$env", container=~"$source"} | regexp `"level":(?P<pnum>\d+)` | regexp `"level":"(?P<jw>\w+)` | regexp `\] (?P<gw>INFO|ERROR|WARNING|DEBUG|NOTICE|FATAL):` | regexp `(?:^|\s)level=(?P<lw>\w+)` | regexp `(?P<stk>^\w*Error:|^\s+at |^Node\.js v)` | regexp `"DownstreamStatus":(?P<dstatus>\d+)` | label_format sev=`{{ if .dstatus }}{{ if hasPrefix "5" .dstatus }}error{{ else if hasPrefix "4" .dstatus }}warn{{ else }}info{{ end }}{{ else if .pnum }}{{ if eq .pnum "60" }}fatal{{ else if eq .pnum "50" }}error{{ else if eq .pnum "40" }}warn{{ else }}info{{ end }}{{ else if .gw }}{{ .gw | lower }}{{ else if .stk }}error{{ else if .lw }}{{ .lw }}{{ else if .jw }}{{ .jw }}{{ else }}other{{ end }}` | sev != "other" |= "$search" [5m]))

{env=~"$env", container=~"$source"} | regexp `"level":(?P<pnum>\d+)` | regexp `"level":"(?P<jw>\w+)` | regexp `\] (?P<gw>INFO|ERROR|WARNING|DEBUG|NOTICE|FATAL):` | regexp `(?:^|\s)level=(?P<lw>\w+)` | regexp `(?P<stk>^\w*Error:|^\s+at |^Node\.js v)` | regexp `"DownstreamStatus":(?P<dstatus>\d+)` | label_format sev=`{{ if .dstatus }}{{ if hasPrefix "5" .dstatus }}error{{ else if hasPrefix "4" .dstatus }}warn{{ else }}info{{ end }}{{ else if .pnum }}{{ if eq .pnum "60" }}fatal{{ else if eq .pnum "50" }}error{{ else if eq .pnum "40" }}warn{{ else }}info{{ end }}{{ else if .gw }}{{ .gw | lower }}{{ else if .stk }}error{{ else if .lw }}{{ .lw }}{{ else if .jw }}{{ .jw }}{{ else }}other{{ end }}` | sev != "other" | sev =~ "(?i).*($level).*" |= "$search"
